# AV Clock Metrics

The figures `avclock` serves through `getMetrics()`, generated from its Key Value Contract [`avclock.kvc`](https://github.com/rdkcentral/rdk-halif-aidl/blob/develop/avclock/kvc/current/avclock.kvc). Every key is served under the requirements in [metrics.md](https://github.com/rdkcentral/rdk-halif-aidl/blob/develop/metrics/current/docs/metrics.md).

## Keys

| Key | Unit | Kind | Access | Identifier | Definition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sync_offset_ms` | ms | current | read | `0x0853e5868c5f2bd8` | The driver's predicted current audio-versus-video presentation offset. Positive when audio leads, negative when video leads. A live sample rather than a cumulative figure. |
| `sync_max_abs_offset_ms` | ms | high_water | read | `0x20d08f573aeb1229` | Largest absolute sync_offset_ms observed. A monotone non-decreasing high-water mark over the life of the resource, and read-only: a maximum cannot be recovered by differencing two maxima, so a consumer wanting the worst excursion within its own reporting window tracks that itself from sync_offset_ms rather than resetting a figure other readers share. |
| `sync_time_over_threshold_ms` | ms | counter | read | `0x323c3766c9e3638c` | Cumulative time the absolute sync_offset_ms exceeded sync_threshold_ms — the time integral of out-of-sync operation. |
| `sync_threshold_ms` | ms | config | read | `0x4c981a6fd5bbf977` | The offset magnitude beyond which playback counts as out of sync. This is the threshold sync_time_over_threshold_ms integrates against and sync_max_abs_offset_ms is judged by, so declaring either of those without this leaves both uninterpretable — reading it is what the key is for. The value is set by product configuration rather than over this interface, so a consumer never has to assume the threshold it was built against is the one in force. |
| `resync_count` | events | counter | read | `0x1e11b09c212e1a59` | Count of A/V-sync corrections the clock applied, one per discrete realignment of audio and video. |
| `resync_magnitude_sum_ms` | ms | counter | read | `0x7be51ba179aa2379` | Sum of the absolute magnitude of each resync correction. Clock-internal, and paired with resync_count so the mean correction size is this divided by that. |
